prior_exposure.consequence: Additional retrospective validation; no blind, untouched or prospective test claim.

protocol.question: Does fixed logistic-regression ranking add top-50 retrieval value beyond prior CTR in an additional later period?
protocol.feature_reuse: Reuse the UNFILTERED May outcome-window aggregate from the verified private cache, relabeling origin and role. Never reuse a filtered May evaluation cohort as June eligibility.
protocol.new_source_scope: Only fact_content_daily_performance/month=2026-06; never the sample table. Aggregate June 1-28. Reuse existing March-May episode data for training.
protocol.eligibility_and_label: Identical to parent protocol: rank all as-of eligible pages before observing outcomes; retain unknown June outcomes.

models.preprocessing: Independent StandardScaler per model, four numeric features only; no tuning or winner selection.

protocol.rules: Training-only position bands (0,3,10,20,50,infinity); medians or pooled CTR; visibility at training median I. High prior counts/CTR rank first.
protocol.arm_definition: Identical rolling-training membership and permanent hash exclusion as parent; report each arm separately.
protocol.reporting: All eight methods and all three arms, cohort flow, coverage, observed hits, unknown counts and logical queue bounds. Paired missing-label bounds are primary for the specified comparison. Complete-case AUC/AP/ranking metrics are secondary.
protocol.unsupported_arms: Report the exact support/status reason. Do not shorten history or alter support thresholds.
protocol.no_tuning: No changes to labels, eligibility, features, methods, thresholds or tie order after June access. Corrections require a dated versioned amendment and disclosure.
protocol.diagnostics: Count-allocation and client-deletion analyses remain descriptive and secondary; never used to select a model or revise labels.
limits: Retrospective final data release without historical ingestion vintages.
Unknown prior June exposure and post-development comparator selection.
Repeated pages/clients and only one additional period; no iid confidence intervals.
Logical missing-label bounds are not confidence intervals.
Retrieval of the count signature does not establish business benefit from editing a page.
protocol.implementation_requirement: A separate June runner must first pass date, unfiltered-feature reuse, outcome-missingness, hash exclusion and source-scope tests. The development notebook continues to exclude June.
